activeQuestion.prompt: Her brother can come today and Saturday. What should he do?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 她哥哥今天和星期六都能來。他應該怎麼做？

options.text: Wait and collect both items on Saturday.
options.zh: 等到星期六一次領兩件。
options.whyZh: 兩件雖可保留到星期六，但她今晚需要桌燈。

options.text: Have her collect the lamp with only her phone today; he comes Saturday.
options.zh: 今天讓她只帶電話來取桌燈，他星期六再來。
options.whyZh: 電話可以查詢，但取貨仍要出示姓名相符的證件。

options.text: Bring matching ID for the lamp today; collect the notebook Saturday after its notice.
options.zh: 今天帶姓名相符的證件領桌燈；收到筆記本通知後，星期六再來領。
options.whyZh: 哥哥可出示與訂單相符的證件，先滿足今晚的桌燈需求；筆記本另行通知後可保留到星期六。

options.text: Collect both today, using the same pickup message for the notebook.
options.zh: 今天用同一則簡訊把兩件都領走。
options.whyZh: 筆記本明天才到，今天不能領；它也會有自己的通知。

group.title: A visit to the pickup counter
group.passage:
Woman: I got a pickup message for my order. I need the lamp tonight, but I’ve lost the order number.
Man: We can search by the order’s phone number. To collect anything, show photo ID matching the name on the order.
Woman: That’s my number, but the order is in my brother’s name. Are my lamp and notebook both ready?
Man: The lamp is here. The notebook arrives tomorrow. We text for each item and hold it through Saturday.
group.passageZh:
女：我收到了訂單的取貨通知。今晚需要桌燈，但我找不到訂單編號。
男：可以用訂單留下的電話號碼查詢。取貨時須出示與訂單姓名相符的附照證件。
女：電話是我的，但訂單是我哥哥的名字。桌燈和筆記本都能取了嗎？
男：桌燈到了。筆記本明天到。我們會對每件商品分別發簡訊，並保留到星期六。
